Folks — reviewed Maria's redline. Summary of proposed position and next steps: 

- Subprocessor notice: accept 15-day notice only with (a) a mandatory ops contact and documented incident-runbook, and (b) explicit carve-in that emergency security updates can be applied sooner. We'll add a clean fallback that any onboarding requiring code-level changes will have a longer notice window.
- SCCs exhibit: we will preserve standard EU SCC language but include a targeted clause clarifying onward transfers to Stellaris affiliates located in APAC, limited to named entities and a defined list of hosting regions. Need Stellaris to confirm the affiliate list and whether they require data localization in APAC.
- Processor role carveouts: we cannot accept open-ended controller-to-processor carveouts. We will accept narrowly scoped telemetry exceptions (as described in Maria's markup) but need explicit functional mapping and a security assurance (KMS/HSM attestation + SOC 2 Type II evidence).

Action items:
1) Olga/Karthik — prepare an evidence bundle list (KMS cert, SOC2 snapshot, subprocessor listing, sample contract with our cloud provider) — we can provide an abbreviated bundle within 48 hours.
2) Ben — confirm commercial runway and whether a small onboarding credit will keep the Q2 pilot intact.
3) Maria/Alex — please provide the affiliate list for APAC and confirm whether any APAC hosts are required for locality (this affects SCC selection).

I've put proposed redline language inline in the attached OrderForm_v3_redline_2027-03-09.pdf and a short legal note (2 pages) that maps each ask to our standard concession matrix. If Stellaris agrees to the evidence bundle and affiliate list, we can produce a handback DPA for review by Wednesday and target DocuSign by Friday.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Contracts | Redwood Inference
